description: On-device Vietnamese TTS model with instant voice cloning from 3-5 seconds of reference audio, English-Vietnamese code-switching, streaming playback, batched generation, and conversation mode.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript matching the reference speaker WAV for ICL voice cloning.

request.name: speaker_embedding_path
request.description: Path to a speaker embedding .emb.txt file containing 192 comma-separated float values.

request.name: speaker_embedding
request.description: Comma-separated list of 192 speaker embedding float values.

request.name: speaker_embedding_only
request.description: Use only the speaker embedding for voice cloning instead of ICL reference codec prompting; default false.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated codec frames; default comes from generation_config.json, 2048 when absent.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Sample the main codec stream instead of greedy decoding; default true.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Main codec top-k sampling limit; default 50, 0 disables top-k filtering.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Main codec nucleus sampling limit; default 1.0.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Positive repetition penalty for the main codec stream; default 1.05.

request.name: subtalker_do_sample
request.description: Enable sampling in the acoustic decoder; default true.

request.name: subtalker_top_k
request.description: Acoustic decoder top-k sampling limit; default 50, 0 disables top-k filtering.

request.name: subtalker_top_p
request.description: Acoustic decoder nucleus sampling limit; default 1.0.

request.name: seed
request.description: Codec sampling seed; omitted requests choose a random seed.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum UTF-8 codepoints per generated text chunk; default 200.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking mode; default word_budget.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release the talker cached-step graph after each request; default false.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared talker and voice-prompt matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: talker_weight_type
session.description: Talker weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: speech_encoder_weight_type
session.description: Reference speech encoder matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: speech_decoder_weight_type
session.description: Speech decoder matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Speech tokenizer and speaker-encoder convolution weight storage type; default f32.

session.name: talker_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Talker graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: speech_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Reference speech encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: speech_decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Speech decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: speaker_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Speaker encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 32.

session.name: talker_constant_context_mb
session.description: Talker constant tensor context size in MiB; default 4096.

session.name: code_predictor_constant_context_mb
session.description: Code predictor constant tensor context size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: speech_decoder_constant_context_mb
session.description: Speech decoder constant tensor context size in MiB; default 1536.
